title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld
description: As her 16th birthday approaches, a not-so-average teen rediscovers the fiery powers she’s long suppressed and is forced to face her demons — literally.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: While celebrating her birthday in Korea, Jentry realizes she can still shoot fire from her hands — and that a ruthless demon's out to steal her soul.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: A portal to the underworld in Texas opens the door to unwelcome guests. A burning secret makes Jentry's first day at Riverfork High School even harder.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Jentry's having haunting visions that seem to reveal the past... but where are they coming from? A determined Gugu trains to master a new skill.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ed tags along on a field trip to the Alamo, where the tour guide's frightening re-enactment of a famous battle goes a bit too far.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Getting closer to Jentry prompts Michael and Kit to think about who they are — and who they really want to be. A new face stalks the halls at school.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Deep-fried snacks, a secret Daoist magic market and a towering demon? A day at the State Fair brings big problems to Texas — really, really big.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While Ed guards the portal to the underworld, Gugu leads Jentry to a dangerous middle realm that holds the answers to questions about her past.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Jentry's got a plan to get rid of her powers so she can finally get her life back. But to pull it off, she'll need Kit's help.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Just when Jentry's starting to feel normal, Michael's worried that he isn't. Spirit Week stirs up big feelings — and plays out on the field with a bang.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Worlds collide in an epic clash as chaos comes to Riverfork, summoning demons to the Homecoming game and putting the whole town in danger.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: A month after the demon attack, Jentry and Ed steal away to Diyu on important family business. But nothing there is quite as it seems.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Armed with her mother's memories, Jentry tries to make up for lost time. Meanwhile, the students prepare for a Lock-In at school.

episodes_data.title: Jentry Chau vs the Underworld Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Tensions hit a boiling point within the walls of Riverfork High when demons crash the party, forcing Jentry and her friends to fight for their lives.
